paragraphs: R' Pinhas, mentioned without further qualification. In R' Abba bar Pappa's name. R' Abba bar Zemina in his name. R' Avin in his name. In R' Elazar ben Menahem's name. In R' Elazar [source spelling אלעזר] ben Yaakov's name: Ruth Rabbah on ‘The man trembled,’ etc., ‘A lyre hung above David's head.’ Also Rav Bibi in bar Pada's name; and Rav Huna. In Rav Huna of Sepphoris's name. In R' Hoshaya's name: Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 5:1:12, Megillah 3:1:4, and Ketubot 13:1:2. Also R' Huna; R' Hizkiyah; R' Hizkiyah the engraver. In R' Hilkiyah the Southerner's name. In R' Hiyya bar Abba's name. In R' Hanina of Kaskata's name: Yalkut, end of Mishpatim. R' Hanina of Sepphoris in his name. Also R' Hananya; R' Yohanan. R' Yohanan ben Mari in his name. In R' Yosi's name. Before R' Yosi: Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 11:2:8. In R' Yosa bar Ilai's name. Also R' Yosef: Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:6:3; R' Yirmeyah; Levi. In R' Menahem of Galya's name. Also R' Simon. In bar Pada's name. In Rav's name: Hagigah 26a. She'erit Yosef likewise lists R' Pinhas among Rav's pupils. Certainly this Gemara misled him; it is a scribal error, and should read ‘in Rava's name,’ as found in Kirah, 46b; Gittin 83b; Nedarim 73b; Bava Metzia 62a; Niddah 46b; Yevamot 29b [22b reads Rav Pappa]—‘in Rava's name.’ Thus he was Rava's pupil. I was greatly pleased to find Rashi on Sanhedrin 85a:16:2: ‘As R' Pinhas said at the end of Homer Ba-Kodesh in Rava's name.’ In Yevamot 22b, ‘in Rav Pappa's name’ is a scribal error, for that matter was stated in Rava's name. In R' Reuven's name: Bereshit Rabbah 75:1. In Yalkut, ‘R' Pinhas bar R' Reuven’ is a scribal error; it should read ‘in R' Reuven's name.’ ‘Rav Pappa said in Rabbi's name’: Bereshit Rabbah, chapter 32 [wording retained]. In R' Shmuel bar Yitzhak's name: Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:8:11 [Heilprin: chapter 3]. In R' Shimon's name: Shekalim chapter 5. In R' Tanhum bar Hanilai's name.
